text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I'm comin' for you, tryouts!<n>UOOOOGHHH!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ever since our little heart-to-heart,<n>Shinko Windy
has been killing it in<n>training, as though all that doom
and<n>gloom was just a bad dream.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She seems dead set on getting a win<n>in the next
tryouts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm ready to offer all the support I<n>can. I'm the one
who egged her on,<n>after all.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Phew! That was a good run! Man,<n>I'm thirsty. Hm?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
What's with this drink? "For Windy?"<n>Who did
this? Meh, drink first, ask<n>questions later!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Gah, it's raining cats and dogs! I can<n>barely see a
meter ahead. And just<n>when I was pumped up for
some<n>training...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if there's any space in the<n>gym. Probably
not, with this weather...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? "Reserved for Shinko Windy"?<n>But why?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Well, fine by me! Looks like I'm<n>gettin' in a good
workout today!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The days fly by, and soon enough<n>tryouts are here.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Wait, the girl with the striped<n>ribbon—isn't she
the one everyone's<n>talkin' about?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Arrrghhhh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the scrimmage I watched before,<n>Windy got
distracted by the other<n>runners in the final stretch,
essentially<n>costing her the race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I think I know why she struggles to<n>focus when it
counts. It's all because<n>of the hit she took to her
confidence.<n>So there's only one thing for it...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, don't need ya to tell me that!<n>Today's goin'
to be a big W for<n>Windy!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Another round of tryouts. 1,600<n>meters on dirt, still
muddy from the<n>rain. The race is about to begin!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's running in a decent position at<n>a controlled
pace, with just enough<n>speed to keep up with the
pack. So<n>far, so good—now for the moment of<n>truth...

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
They're off the fourth corner and into<n>the stretch!
It's a battle for the lead!<n>Shinko Windy is eyeing the
front!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
(My target's right there—I just gotta<n>drag her
down! Then I'll be in the<n>lead!)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I see a sparkle in her eyes. Her legs<n>tense, and
then...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: C'mon, hold that lead till the finish!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
They're closing in, but you can do it!<n>Go, you got
this!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: (...No, no, no! I have to focus!)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
(Remember what Trainer said! You're<n>a genius, and
wicked cool—the gem of<n>Japan, with a bright future
ahead of<n>you!)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
(You can win, you can do<n>this—remember those
words!)
choice_data_list: You got this in the bag, Windy!
You got this in the bag, Windy!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
This is it. I'm gonna win. I'm gonna<n>win! I'm gonna
WIN! Windy's gonna<n>win!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna WIIIIN!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With a howl, she kicks up mud and<n>barrels forward,
as if threatening to<n>sweep everything out of her
path.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And just like that, she wins.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Huff, wheeze...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Well, that's too bad... But that girl who<n>won was
amazing! Shinko Windy,<n>was it? She was fierce!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, almost like a wild animal. I<n>wonder when
she's going to debut.<n>That'll be exciting!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hehe... hehehe! Heeheehee!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Well, well, well! Do you all understand<n>now? Windy
is unstoppable!<n>Heeheehee!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After Windy crosses the finish, I'm<n>left speechless,
covered in<n>goosebumps.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She was a hurricane, leveling<n>everything in its path.
But most<n>striking of all was her fixation on<n>victory,
the drive to take that one last<n>step.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Going into this, I thought it'd be nice if<n>she could
regain some confidence<n>and have fun running
again. But<n>now...
choice_data_list: She can do so much more!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I knew she had talent. But that's an
understatement. She could be a<n>prodigy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
By the time I make it down to the<n>track, Windy is
already surrounded by<n>other trainers.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Huh? Scout? Wait, you too? You want<n>me?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Oho! You all have a good eye! But...<n>Windy already
knows who her<n>prey's gonna be...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I flail my arms about, desperate to gether attention. I need to sign a contractwith this girl.
